t2.title: Children be taught financial literacy and money management in schools
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should children be taught financial literacy and money management in schools?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Music Festivals: Are They Worth the Investment?

As festival ticket prices continue to rise, many music lovers question whether the experience justifies the cost. Having attended several festivals, I believe they can be worth it – with some caveats.

Firstly, festivals offer unique experiences that concerts cannot replicate. Seeing multiple artists over several days, discovering new bands, and enjoying the festival atmosphere creates lasting memories.

Moreover, when you calculate the cost per artist, festivals often offer better value than individual concerts.

However, hidden costs add up quickly – food, drinks, camping equipment, and travel can double the expense.

Additionally, comfort is often sacrificed. Poor weather, crowded conditions, and inadequate facilities can diminish the experience.

Ultimately, value depends on priorities. For dedicated music fans, the experience is priceless. For casual listeners, smaller local events might offer better value for money.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I go to music festival. It was fun. Music good. Food good. I like music.
Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hi!
I went to the music festival. It was good. The music was nice and I liked the food. It was a little bit expensive, but it was fun. I saw many bands. I liked the festival because I met new people and we danced. I want to go next year. It was very hot, but I had a good time.
Bye!
t2.sampleB1:
The music festival was a good experience. I liked the music a lot. There were many different bands, and I discovered some new artists I really enjoyed. The food was okay, but a bit expensive, I think. The facilities were quite crowded, especially the toilets.

I think the festival could be better next year if they had more toilets and maybe some more places to sit down. Also, the prices for drinks were too high. If they improved these things, I would definitely go again. Overall, it was a fun weekend, but there is room for improvement.
t2.sampleB2:
Money Matters: Why Schools Should Teach Financial Literacy

Ask any teenager to name a chart-topping song and they'll answer in seconds – but ask them how a credit card actually works, and you'll likely be met with a blank stare. This is exactly why financial literacy deserves a place on the school timetable.

For a start, money management is a skill we all need, yet many young people leave school without the faintest idea of how to budget, save or steer clear of debt. By the time they reach adulthood, bad habits have often already set in. Teaching the basics early would give students a real head start in life.

What's more, the lessons could be genuinely hands-on. Imagine pupils opening mock bank accounts, planning a monthly budget or weighing up the true cost of a loan. Skills like these stick far better than dry theory.

Of course, some argue the curriculum is already packed. However, few subjects prove as useful in everyday life. In short, if we want the next generation to stand on their own two feet, financial literacy is a lesson well worth teaching.
t2.uzSample:
Musiqa festivallari: Ular sarmoyaga arziydimi?

Festival chiptalarining narxi o'sishda davom etar ekan, ko'plab musiqa ixlosmandlari bu tajriba xarajatni oqlaydimi, degan savolga javob izlashadi. Bir nechta festivallarda qatnashganimdan so'ng, menimcha, ular bunga arziydi – ba'zi shartlar bilan.

Birinchidan, festivallar konsertlar takrorlay olmaydigan noyob tajribalarni taqdim etadi. Bir necha kun davomida ko'plab san'atkorlarni ko'rish, yangi guruhlarni kashf qilish va festival muhitidan bahramand bo'lish unutilmas xotiralarni yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, har bir san'atkor uchun xarajatni hisoblasangiz, festivallar ko'pincha alohida konsertlarga qaraganda yaxshiroq qiymat taklif qiladi.

Biroq, yashirin xarajatlar tezda qo'shiladi – oziq-ovqat, ichimliklar, lager uskunalari va sayohat xarajatlarni ikki baravar oshirishi mumkin.

Qolaversa, qulaylik ko'pincha qurbon qilinadi. Yomon ob-havo, olomon va yetarli bo'lmagan sharoitlar tajribani kamaytirishi mumkin.

Oxir oqibat, qiymat ustuvorliklarga bog'liq. Musiqaga sodiq muxlislar uchun bu tajriba bebaho. Oddiy tinglovchilar uchun esa, kichikroq mahalliy tadbirlar pulga nisbatan yaxshiroq qiymat taklif qilishi mumkin.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men musiqa festivaliga bordim. Qiziqarli bo'ldi. Musiqa yaxshi. Ovqat yaxshi. Menga musiqa yoqadi.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom!
Men musiqa festivaliga bordim. Yaxshi bo'ldi. Musiqa yoqimli edi va menga ovqat ham yoqdi. Bir oz qimmat edi, lekin qiziqarli bo'ldi. Men ko'plab guruhlarni ko'rdim. Menga festival yoqdi, chunki men yangi odamlar bilan tanishdim va biz raqsga tushdik. Keyingi yili ham bormoqchiman. Juda issiq edi, lekin vaqtim yaxshi o'tdi.
Xayr!
t2.uzSampleB1:
Musiqa festivali yaxshi tajriba bo'ldi. Menga musiqa juda yoqdi. U yerda ko'plab turli guruhlar bor edi va men o'zimga juda yoqqan yangi artistlarni kashf qildim. Ovqat yaxshi edi, lekin biroz qimmat, menimcha. Qulayliklar juda gavjum edi, ayniqsa hojatxonalar.

O'ylaymanki, agar ular ko'proq hojatxonalarga ega bo'lsalar va balki o'tirish uchun ko'proq joylar bo'lsa, festival kelgusi yilda yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Bundan tashqari, ichimliklar narxi juda yuqori edi. Agar ular bu narsalarni yaxshilashsa, men albatta yana borardim. Umuman olganda, bu qiziqarli dam olish kuni bo'ldi, lekin yaxshilanishga joy bor.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan musiqa festivalida qatnashish turli xil taassurotlarni qoldirdi. Dasturda turli xil artistlar va janrlar namoyish etilgan bo'lsa-da, umumiy tashkilotchilik yaxshiroq bo'lishi mumkin edi. Musiqaning xilma-xilligi, albatta, kuchli tomon bo'lib, indie rokdan tortib elektron raqs musiqasigacha hamma uchun nimadir bor edi. Yangi artistlarni kashf qilish alohida ta'kidlashga arziydi.

Biroq, qulayliklar ko'pincha yetarli emas edi. Hojatxonalar va oziq-ovqat sotuvchilari oldida uzun navbatlar odatiy hol edi va o'tirish joylari tashrif buyuruvchilar soni uchun yetarli emas edi. Bu umumiy zavqga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Takroriy tashriflarni rag'batlantirish uchun tashkilotchilar ushbu asosiy qulayliklarni yaxshilashga ustuvor ahamiyat berishlari kerak. Ehtimol, sotuvchilar sonini ko'paytirish va yanada samarali navbat tizimini joriy etish tirbandlikni kamaytirishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, ko'proq soyali joylar va qulay o'tirish joylarini ta'minlash festival tajribasini sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi. Yakuniy xulosa shuki, musiqa a'lo darajada bo'lsa-da, yetarli qulayliklarning yo'qligi umumiy qiymatni pasaytirdi.

t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who also attended. Write about your feelings and what you think the organizers should do.
t11.sample: Hey! What did you think of the festival? I absolutely loved the headliners! But the food stalls were so expensive! I hope they get more variety next year. Which band was your favorite? Can't wait for next year!

O'ylaymanki, tashkilotchilar bunga albatta e'tibor berishlari kerak. Ehtimol, ko'proq sotuvchilar yoki yaxshiroq navbat tizimi yordam berishi mumkin. Senda qanday taassurotlar qoldi?
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Nodira Tojiyeva

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the festival organizers. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear Festival Organizers,

Thank you for organizing such an enjoyable event. I am pleased to share my feedback.

Firstly, the music lineup was outstanding. The variety of genres catered to different tastes effectively.

However, the food prices were rather high. More affordable options would be appreciated by attendees.

Additionally, the toilet facilities were insufficient for the crowd size, leading to long queues. Increasing the number of facilities would greatly improve the experience.

Furthermore, I would suggest adding more shaded areas for rest, as the sun was intense.

Despite these points, it was a memorable experience and I will definitely return.

Best wishes,
An Enthusiastic Attendee
t12.sampleA1:
Hi!
The music is good. I like music. The food is ok. Bye!
t12.sampleA2:
Hello,

I liked the music festival. The music was good and I liked the bands. But the toilets were not very good. There were long lines. I think you need more toilets next year. And the food was expensive. It should be cheaper. Thank you.

Bye,
A Happy Person
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Festival Organizers,

Thank you for the music festival. I enjoyed the music very much. I think the bands were great and there was a good variety of music.

However, I think there could be some improvements. For example, the food was quite expensive. Also, there weren't enough toilets, so there were long queues. I think you should have more toilets next year.

In my opinion, if you improve these things, more people will come next year. I would like to come again.

Sincerely,
A Festival Goer
t12.sampleB2:
Dear Festival Organizers,

I am writing to share some feedback following your recent music festival, which I attended last weekend.

On the whole, I had a wonderful time. The lineup was superb and I was delighted to discover several new artists. That said, there are a few areas that I feel need addressing.

Firstly, the food and drink prices were far too high. Bringing in a wider range of affordable vendors would go down well with attendees. Secondly, the toilet facilities simply could not cope with the crowds, and the long queues took the shine off an otherwise great day. I would strongly encourage you to add more facilities and shaded seating for next year.

Despite these drawbacks, I thoroughly enjoyed myself and would happily return.

Yours faithfully,
Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli festival tashkilotchilari,

Shunday yoqimli tadbirni tashkil qilganingiz uchun rahmat. O'z fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirganimdan mamnunman.

Avvalo, musiqiy dastur ajoyib edi. Janrlarning xilma-xilligi turli xil didlarga samarali tarzda moslashdi.

Biroq, oziq-ovqat narxlari ancha yuqori edi. Arzonroq variantlar tashrif buyuruvchilar tomonidan qadrlanadi.

Bundan tashqari, hojatxonalar soni odamlar soniga yetarli emas edi, bu esa uzun navbatlarga olib keldi. Hojatxonalar sonini ko'paytirish tajribani sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi.

Bundan tashqari, quyosh juda qizdirgani sababli, dam olish uchun soyali joylarni ko'proq qo'shishni taklif qilaman.

Shu nuqtalarga qaramay, bu unutilmas tajriba bo'ldi va men albatta qaytib kelaman.

Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Ishqiboz ishtirokchi

t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli festival tashkilotchilari,

Musiqa festivali uchun rahmat. Menga musiqa juda yoqdi. O'ylashimcha, guruhlar ajoyib edi va musiqa xilma-xilligi yaxshi edi.

Biroq, o'ylaymanki, ba'zi yaxshilanishlar bo'lishi mumkin. Masalan, ovqat juda qimmat edi. Shuningdek, hojatxonalar yetarli emas edi, shuning uchun uzun navbatlar bor edi. O'ylaymanki, kelgusi yilda ko'proq hojatxonalar bo'lishi kerak.

Mening fikrimcha, agar siz bu narsalarni yaxshilasangiz, kelgusi yilda ko'proq odamlar keladi. Men yana kelishni xohlardim.

Hurmat bilan,
Festivalga tashrif buyuruvchi
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli festival tashkilotchilari,

Musiqa festivalini tashkil etganingiz uchun rahmat; men uni umuman olganda ijobiy tajriba deb topdim va fikr-mulohazalar bildirish imkoniyatini berganingizdan minnatdorman.

Musiqiy dastur, umuman olganda, yaxshi tuzilgan edi. Janrlarning xilma-xilligi har bir kishi uchun nimadir topilishini ta'minladi va men o'zimga yoqqan bir nechta yangi san'atkorlarni kashf qildim. Biroq, oziq-ovqat va ichimliklar narxlari juda baland edi. Arzonroq variantlarni taklif qilish, ehtimol, tashrif buyuruvchilarga o'z ichimliklarini olib kelishga ruxsat berish, mamnuniyat bilan qabul qilinadigan o'zgarish bo'lardi.

Bundan tashqari, hojatxonalar soni tashrif buyuruvchilar soniga mos emas edi. Natijada hosil bo'lgan navbatlar noqulay edi va umumiy tajribani buzdi. Kelajakdagi tadbirlar uchun hojatxonalar sonini ko'paytirish muhim. Shuningdek, ko'proq o'rindiqli joylarni, ayniqsa soyali joylarni ta'minlash foydali bo'lardi, ayniqsa kunning eng issiq qismlarida.

Ushbu muammolarga qaramay, festival menga yoqdi va agar ushbu yaxshilanishlar amalga oshirilsa, yana tashrif buyurishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Hurmat bilan,
Festival ishtirokchisi
